content: Removing direct identifiers (name, email) is insufficient for anonymization; quasi-identifiers (age, gender, zip/location, free-text comments, timestamps) can re-identify individuals when combined with public data or small sample sizes — 63% of a population can be uniquely identified by gender+DOB+zip alone (Sweeney). Netflix Prize dataset de-anonymization is the canonical cautionary example. Small survey samples (e.g. a workplace or class survey) are especially vulnerable since respondents are a known, small, guessable population.
